## TASK-001 - Freeze implementation baseline and content/caller inventory

Capture the actual checkout, protected-file hashes/timestamps, current launch identity, relevant read/agent/Template results and all active workbench callers. Inventory selected canonical types, predicates, sources and supported process fields/order across linked sections. Inspect current initializer edition/resource callers and updater shipping exclusions, including publication intents/recovery state relevant to selected canonical inputs.

### Risks

- Fresh baseline must be captured again if user edits or governing inputs change; inspection/read checks cannot install profiles.

### Acceptance criteria

- The baseline distinguishes pre-existing edits/failures, reader functionality and history; every candidate retirement caller is classified as runtime, shared helper, test, launcher, docs, distribution or historical.
- Each process field/order claim has exact source support or an unexamined/absent classification; no canonical content is added to fill a demonstration gap.
- The local-file 347-record inventory and complete 412-record loaded inventory retain their different scopes; a canonical process identity is a lead, not evidence of ordered process steps.

### Planned verification

- Record git rev-parse HEAD, git status --short, selected file SHA256 and stat mtime_ns, interpreter and current explicit launcher behavior without copying session URLs.
- Run PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 .venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s SKILLS-depo/ontology/tests -p test_query_retrieval.py -v and the same command with test_publication.py; capture actual results.
- Run .venv/bin/python tools/template_update.py check and installed core check_ontology.py with exact root; assess any required existing advanced backend before a separate broader test invocation.

### Risks

- An incompatible renderer CSP or license finding returns to design review before adopting a workaround; no broad CSP relaxation.
- Stable pre/post file digests cannot establish a complete transaction when publication stopped after only some canonical replacements.
- Existing dist/build exclusions and initializer v9 resource requirements constrain shipping; do not silently weaken either contract.

### Acceptance criteria

- Contracts define exact request/envelope/error/cursor shapes and numeric request/time/concurrency/cache limits subordinate to canonical limits.
- Selected dependency versions, build-only Node version, built-in layout, notices and source provenance are pinned after current primary-source review; any required installation has separate recorded authority.
- The contract includes selected-input unresolved-transaction detection, bounded coherent snapshot reads, precise source-reference identity, per-service and per-session cursor scope, independent List normalization and shared state/route ownership.
- The change map names source files, generated Template destinations, prospective exact root adoption and current initializer capability compatibility; each preserves its independent authority boundary.

### Planned verification

- Check current official TypeScript, Cytoscape.js, Vite and dependency license sources for the exact chosen versions.
- Review schema compatibility and import boundaries against existing canonical loader/CLI/workbench callers; no new ontology store/engine or source truth is introduced.
- Review existing publication intent/receipt/recovery and lock creation semantics, updater exclusions, strict configuration and current initializer resource inventories before approving the proposed contracts.
